description: An addon that allows you to add custom labels for unlabeled controls and edit existing ones.
changelog: * Fixed a performance regression where navigating in browse mode or opening the Elements List (NVDA+F7) in applications with no custom labels caused unnecessary COM queries for every node in the virtual buffer.
